  "question": "Assess Inland Stores's reported inventory service level. I need the following measured result: September order-line fill rate from stock and the change from August on the same customer cohort.",
  "gap": "September order-line fill rate from stock and the change from August on the same customer cohort.",
  "passages": [
    "I began with the underlying record, then checked the units against the stated scope of the exercise.

Inland's line ledger reports stock fill rates of 91% in August and 95% in September for matched customers, a gain of 4 percentage points.

Background to the observation: Inland increased safety stocks at its regional depot.

A comparison should use the same unit on both sides. A percentage-point change is different from a percentage change. A nameplate limit is also different from measured delivery under operating conditions.

SYNTHETIC benchmark article. People, records and quantities in this standalone research fixture are invented."
  ]
}
